standard_prerequisites.name: Affineness of a nonvanishing locus inside an affine nonvanishing locus
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the opens X_{tau_J} as affine whenever one of the tensor factors has index zero.

core_obligations: Use quasi-compactness to select finitely many pairs (L_i, s_i) with L_i globally generated, X_{s_i} affine and X covered by the X_{s_i} (proof lines 7903-7906).
For each i choose finitely many sections t_{i,j} of L_i whose nonvanishing loci cover X, and set t_{i,0} = s_i (proof lines 7907-7909).
Form the tensor product L of the L_i and the product sections tau_J = t_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor t_{n,j_n} indexed by the tuples J (proof lines 7910-7919).
Show X_{tau_J} is affine as soon as some j_i = 0, verify that the X_{tau_J} cover X, and conclude that L is ample by definition (proof lines 7920-7923).
proof_roadmap: Select a finite family of affine nonvanishing loci covering X.
Complete each to a finite covering by nonvanishing loci of its sheaf.
Tensor the sheaves and multiply the sections.
Check the ampleness criterion on the resulting affine opens.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs an ample invertible sheaf on a quasi-compact scheme X from the local existence of globally generated pairs (L, s) with x in X_s and X_s affine. The proof chooses finitely many such pairs covering X by quasi-compactness, then for each i chooses finitely many sections t_{i,j} of L_i whose nonvanishing loci cover X, and forms the tensor product L of the L_i together with the product sections tau_J = t_{1,j_1} tensor ... tensor t_{n,j_n} (proof lines 7903-7919). It then invokes the affinity criterion for intersections of nonvanishing loci to see that X_{tau_J} is affine whenever one index j_i is zero, checks that these opens cover X, and concludes ampleness by the definition (proof lines 7920-7923). H2: the two-step finite covering argument and the verification of the ampleness criterion are the substance.
